summary: bin/summarize.py implements all documented rules and out/summary.json was produced with it, using the documented factors (1 lb = 0.45392 kg, 1 oz = 0.02837 kg). The checker's reference figures instead match the real factors (0.45359237 / 0.0283495231): with those every value agrees, with the documented ones the total_kg of 6 depots and 4 months disagree; I did not override the documentation, so the doc and the reference need reconciling (change FACT in the script if the doc is wrong).
